nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (every 15m)
nodes.notes: Synth reminder schedule. Trigger label TICK_15M. NO credentials/secrets stored in workflow JSON. Signing uses the hrpAutomationSigner node + hrpAutomationLegacySignature credential (N8N/1.1).

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (daily digest 09:00 ICT)
nodes.notes: Daily morning digest. Same downstream flow as 15-min trigger. The 15-min tick and the daily digest converge to the same idempotency key per (nextActionId, day, audience, workflowRevision) so AC #15 holds. Signing path is via hrpAutomationSigner.

nodes.name: Build envelope (listDueNextActions)
nodes.notes: N8N/1.1: envelope includes connectionId and serviceId at the top level (the legacy signer hashes them via the scopeKey). No raw PII or secret. Window key is the UTC-minute bucket. correlationId is derived from stable fields only.

nodes.name: Sign envelope (listDueNextActions)
nodes.notes: N8N/1.1 custom signer node. Resolves the hrpAutomationLegacySignature credential at execution time. Output: headers (4 X-Hrp-Automation-* entries) + envelope echo + signerProfile marker. NO secret persists in workflow JSON, output items, or execution data.

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/dispatch (listDueNextActions)
nodes.notes: N8N/1.1: the four X-Hrp-Automation-* headers come from the signer node output. authentication.type='none' (no built-in HMAC type in n8n); signing happens upstream in the hrpAutomationSigner node.

nodes.name: Filter + Group (snooze, slaBucket, per-nextActionId)
nodes.notes: C-N11-02: emits one item per nextActionId, sorted by (dueAt, nextActionId). C-N11-01: classifies each item as routing = SEND | FALLBACK so the downstream Switch can pick exactly one ack-builder.

nodes.name: Build sendSyntheticReminder batches
nodes.notes: C-N11-02: one item per nextActionId. C-N11-03: ackBase derived from stable fields; no Date.now / Math.random. Top-level connectionId/serviceId added for signer compatibility (N8N/1.1).

nodes.name: Switch routing (SEND vs FALLBACK)
nodes.notes: C-N11-01: IF/Switch picks exactly one downstream branch per item. Index 0 = SEND, Index 1 = FALLBACK. The two branches converge ONCE into Build acknowledgement batches.

nodes.name: Sign envelope (sendSyntheticReminder)
nodes.notes: N8N/1.1 custom signer node. Secret resolved from the credential store, never stored in the workflow JSON or item output.

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/dispatch (sendSyntheticReminder)
nodes.notes: N8N/1.1: signed headers come from the upstream hrpAutomationSigner node.

nodes.name: Build ack from send
nodes.notes: C-N11-03: ackBase is deterministic and propagated from the send envelope.

parameters.functionCode:
const fb = $input.first().json || {};
return [{ json: { source: 'fallback', logicalId: fb.logicalId, correlationId: fb.correlationId, organizationId: fb.organizationId, nextActionId: fb.nextActionId, audience: fb.audience, slaBucket: fb.slaBucket, notificationOutcome: 'SKIPPED', reminderRevisionId: fb.reminderRevisionId, ackBase: fb.ackBase, reason: fb.reason } }];

nodes.name: Build ack from fallback
nodes.notes: C-N11-03: deterministic ackBase derived from (nextActionId, day, audience). No Date.now / Math.random.

nodes.name: Build acknowledgement batches
nodes.notes: C-N11-01: both branches converge here. C-N11-03: dedupe guard on ackBase ensures one ack per logical reminder. Top-level connectionId/serviceId added for signer compatibility (N8N/1.1).

nodes.name: Sign envelope (acknowledgeReminder)
nodes.notes: N8N/1.1 custom signer node. Secret resolved from the credential store, never stored in the workflow JSON or item output.

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/dispatch (acknowledgeReminder)
nodes.notes: N8N/1.1: signed headers come from the upstream hrpAutomationSigner node.

parameters.content:
## n8n/1.1 — SLA Reminder (SIGNED variant, LOCAL/MOCK PoC, worktree n8n11-r1)

### Status
Signed variant of the N8N/1.0 SLA reminder. workflowRevision=3. Uses the private custom node package `n8n-nodes-hrp-signer` (hrpAutomationSigner + hrpAutomationLegacySignature credential). Secret lives in n8n credential store ONLY.

### Known divergence from current gateway (Sep 2026)
The current build of apps/integration-api/src/automation/gateway.ts computes the digest via `payloadDigestHex(canonicalJson(stripped))` which double-canonicalises the envelope (gateway digest is SHA-256(canonical(canonical(stripped)))). The N8N/0.2 CONTRACT.md §1 mandates `SHA-256(canonicalJson(stripped))` (single canonical). The signer follows the contract; the gateway needs a one-line change to `payloadDigestHex(stripped)` for the live round-trip to verify.
This workflow can be imported but VERIFICATION at /v1/automation/dispatch will yield 401 until the gateway is aligned. Local tests under tools/n8n-nodes-hrp-signer/test/* all pass without the gateway.

### Flow (per item)
  1. Trigger: 15-min tick OR daily 09:00 ICT digest.
  2. Build envelope (listDueNextActions). Top-level connectionId/serviceId + correlationId + workflowRevision=3.
  3. Sign envelope (listDueNextActions) -> hrpAutomationSigner reads credential store.
  4. POST /v1/automation/dispatch (list) with the four X-Hrp-Automation-* headers.
  5. Filter snoozeMode==SNOOZED and status!=OPEN; bucket DUE_SOON / OVERDUE.
     Sort by (dueAt, nextActionId). Emit ONE item per nextActionId.
  6. Build sendSyntheticReminder batches -> emit kind=send or kind=fallback per item.
  7. Switch routing: kind=send -> Sign envelope (send) -> POST /v1/automation/dispatch (send) -> Build ack from send.
     kind=fallback -> Build ack from fallback (no HTTP send call).
  8. Build acknowledgement batches (dedupe by ackBase) -> Sign envelope (acknowledgeReminder) -> POST /v1/automation/dispatch (acknowledgeReminder).

### Boundaries
  - body organizationId is NEVER authority; registry-resolved org/conn wins.
  - Workflow never mutates NextAction state, Handling SLA, canonical state.
  - Snooze affects notification ONLY; SLA/canonical unchanged.
  - Idempotency keys derived from (nextActionId, day, audience, workflowRevision). No Date.now() / Math.random().
  - Logs are redacted; no secret, signature, raw body, PII.
  - Synthetic channel only (DASHBOARD_ONLY); no email/SMS/Zalo/Chatwoot.
  - One acknowledgement per logical reminder (dedupe by ackBase).
  - Reorder-safe: items are sorted by (dueAt, nextActionId) before key derivation.
  - Secret lives in n8n credential store ONLY (hrpAutomationLegacySignature credential). NEVER in workflow JSON, output items, logs, or execution data.

### Local only
  - active=false. n8n-crm will not start the workflow until T0 issues the import command and operator provisions env vars + the n8n-nodes-hrp-signer npm package.
  - DO NOT IMPORT into a production n8n CRM instance until T0/T1 approves.
  - JSON_STRUCTURE_VERIFIED, LOCAL_TESTS_PASS (35 pass + 1 skip + 1 diagnostic), N8N_RUNTIME_NOT_EXECUTED.

signerProfile.secretStorage: n8n credential store only (NEVER in workflow JSON, output items, logs, trace)
